findings.message: The received file has the required 1536x1024 landscape canvas, no alpha channel, exactly three separated studies, no characters, no story action, and no generated labels or dialogue.

The prior glossy/cinematic floor problem is substantially resolved. Puddles are now mostly bounded matte gray shapes with sparse contour and ripple marks, reflected architecture and long white specular streaks are largely absent, and lighting is flatter across all three studies.
Repeated arched windows, tiled wall bands, iron columns, roof structure, clocks, and the Cafe Siete grille establish a coherent single station across all three views.

The image remains more uniformly etched and architecturally rendered than the approved manga examples. Roof panels, ironwork, cracked plaster, stained glass, tile, and distant platform structures carry similarly dense line and texture treatment, reducing the required selective detail, quiet secondary surfaces, open whites, and strong focal hierarchy.
The large ticket-hall clock clearly reads about 12:05: the minute hand points to numeral I. It does not show the required 12:07 position between I and II and visibly past I.

The PNG is encoded as RGB and its channels are not identical. Mean RGB values are approximately 140.81, 139.72, and 138.18, with a maximum red-blue difference of 19, so it retains a subtle warm tint rather than satisfying the true grayscale/no-tint contract.

No v004 image job or ChatGPT handoff was released. The file is accepted as an author-submitted manual retry for review, but its exact external prompt and attachment use cannot be independently verified from the PNG.
No image was edited, filtered, regenerated, converted, renamed, or promoted during review. Byte-identical copies are retained only as review evidence and possible correction input.
